race.description: In Memory Of Noel Smith Hcp (58)
race.comment: KHARIF (4) broke the maiden status at Port Macquarie last time out and is sure to have derived a bunch of confidence from that victory. Maps nicely for this from gate two and looks the runner in this line-up with the most upside. Can go back-to-back. MONTE CARLO MISS (7) just ran into one better at the Gold Coast at the latest effort and seems to be working up to another win. Looms as the main danger. HE IS THE KISS (2) boasts a win over this course and distance and draws the inside alley. Should be in this for a long way. BETTER YET (5) is ready to peak now fourth run back and may earn some minor money. CONSTANT CAFE (6) best of the rest with the claim.
